Weekday usage increased by 5% across all time slots. In contrast, morning visits decreased by 27% on holidays and 14% on nearby office holidays, while weekends also saw a decrease.

**【分析総括】** The increase in weekday usage was offset by a reduction in visitation during holidays and weekends.

**【分析総括】** Rainy days and heavy rain days were more frequent than the 5-year average, while heatwave days were fewer than last year.

### 運営上の出来事
The summer vacation campaign resulted in an increase, with growth levels similar to the previous year, although the operator views it as slightly lower than the same period last year.

### 総括
Total visitors were 8825, and members have seen a 6-month consecutive decline. Weekday usage increased, while holidays and weekends saw a decrease. Rainy days and heavy rain days were more frequent than the 5-year average, while heatwave days were fewer than last year. The summer vacation campaign showed growth levels similar to the previous year.
